name: Hanada Kirame
source: Kirame is a second-year at Shindouji Girls' High School and the vanguard of its mahjong club. She previously attended Takatoobara Middle School in Nagano Prefecture and was once [url=/c34911]Yuuki[/url] and [url=/c34908]Nodoka's[/url] upperclassman. Kirame is the easily excitable type. She has always been shown as cheerful, fearless and strong-willed, even when the odds were against her, and even finishes her battles with a large smile on her face despite losing the most points. She has a habit of saying "wonderful" (subara! すばら!).
